actors.name: CFO

actors.name: CMO

The CMO has a decent working relationship with the CFO and meets weekly. The CMO wants the revised budget approved before the leadership offsite.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. The CFO and CMO are aware of the revised Q4 budget proposal and the upcoming offsite. No decision has been made yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CFO communicated approval of the revised Q4 budget to the marketing team (or the CMO) before 2026-09-21T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
